BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current C l - l , Neighborhood Commercial District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 15-N in the area bounded by:

              A line 1,452.0 feet north of and parallel to West Ardmore Avenue; North Northwest
              Highway; a line 1,310.0 feet north of and parallel to West Ardmore Avenue; and
              the Chicago and North Western Railroad right-of-way west of and parallel to North
              Northwest Highway

to those ofa C2-I, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
